name: zfmv_action_play_sound_begin
description: zFMV_ActionPlaySound::Begin looks up the configured sample name, stops an existing voice when present, and starts the found sample at full gain.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zFMV action/source-file pass.

The native smoke covers the deterministic missing-sample path; successful playback and existing-voice stop behavior are accepted through the already functional direct callees zSnd::FindSampleByName, zSndPlayHandle::StopIfActive, and zSndSample::PlayA3DSimple.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x462e90 validates sampleName lookup through zSnd::FindSampleByName, sample storage, optional existing voice StopIfActive, optional PlayA3DSimple(1.0f), voice storage, and callee cleanup for the double argument.

The dependency frontier shows no source blockers: zSnd::FindSampleByName is functional-equivalent and tier S, zSndPlayHandle::StopIfActive is functional-equivalent, and zSndSample::PlayA3DSimple is functional-equivalent.
The native smoke verifies the missing-sample path clears the sample field and leaves voice null.
